Coram : R. BANUMATHI, A.S. BOPANNA, HRISHIKESH ROY
U.P. Urban Buildings (Regulation of Letting, Rent and Eviction) Act, 1972 – s.2(1)(a) – Eviction – Appellant initiated the petition u/s.2(1)(a) against the predecessor of the respondents seeking release of the suit property/premises – The prescribed and held that appellant cannot claim ownership right over the coparcenary property and he was not the landlord of the respondents and also held that his bonafide requirement did not exist – The Appellate Authority on re-appreciating the entire aspect of the matter arrived at conclusion
Decision Date : 15-11-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6572/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
